# facelets, a tab, then the moves up to the 3x3x3 hand-off. Recorded once with the Java build
# and tools/bench/FourDriver.java (the first 24 cubes of its Random(1) generator); the Rust
# port must reproduce them exactly. The 3x3x3 tail differs (another solver). Never edit to make a change pass.
